subject.title: [Mac App] node.invoke system.run causes WebSocket disconnection on macOS

question: Should maintainers require a signed current-main macOS companion-app live repro before any fix PR is queued for this `system.run` disconnect report?
rationale: The source path remains present, but the read-only review cannot prove whether the current failure is executor blocking, WebSocket/tick handling, broader macOS node flapping, or environment-specific network behavior.

options.title: Run Signed Current-main Repro
options.body: Pair a signed current-main macOS app with a gateway, run the reporter's medium-duration node command path, and capture redacted macOS app plus gateway logs before changing code.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Mac Node Flapping
options.body: Treat this as partial evidence for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83958 only if maintainers confirm the same root cause after live diagnostics.

options.title: Close Only After Negative Repro
options.body: Close later only if a current-main signed-app retest cannot reproduce the disconnect and no related logs show the same path failing.

recommendation.title: Run Signed Current-main Repro
recommendation.body: Pair a signed current-main macOS app with a gateway, run the reporter's medium-duration node command path, and capture redacted macOS app plus gateway logs before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: The ShellExecutor and macOS exec history make this the best available routing owner for deciding the live proof path.
